description: This file defines a class 'CocoGenerator' for generating and processing data from the COCO dataset, including loading images, annotations, and mapping labels.

classes.name: CocoGenerator
classes.description: A data generator class for the COCO dataset, capable of loading images, annotations, and label mappings.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the COCO data generator with dataset directory and set name, loads annotations and image IDs.

methods.name: load_classes
methods.description: Loads class-to-label mappings and inverse mappings from the COCO dataset.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of images in the dataset.

methods.name: num_classes
methods.description: Returns the number of classes in the dataset, typically 80 for COCO.

methods.name: has_label
methods.description: Checks if a label is known in the dataset.

methods.name: has_name
methods.description: Checks if a class name is known in the dataset.

methods.name: name_to_label
methods.description: Converts a class name to its label index.

methods.name: label_to_name
methods.description: Converts a label index to its class name.

methods.name: coco_label_to_label
methods.description: Maps a COCO dataset label to the internal label used in the network.

methods.name: coco_label_to_name
methods.description: Maps a COCO dataset label to the class name.

methods.name: label_to_coco_label
methods.description: Maps an internal label to the corresponding COCO dataset label.

methods.name: image_path
methods.description: Returns the file path for an image given its index.

methods.name: image_aspect_ratio
methods.description: Calculates the aspect ratio of an image given its index.

methods.name: load_image
methods.description: Loads an image from disk as a BGR image array.

methods.name: load_annotations
methods.description: Loads bounding box annotations and labels for a given image index.
